title: Water State
statement: Write a function `waterState(temp)` that returns "ice" if temperature is 0 or below, "steam" if 100 or above, and "liquid" otherwise.
example: waterState(-5) returns "ice"; waterState(100) returns "steam"; waterState(25) returns "liquid".
prewrittenHints: Compare against the freezing point and boiling point.
Check if cold enough for ice or hot enough for vapor.
Output ice, steam, or liquid depending on which range holds.
conceptNote: Branch on freezing and boiling thresholds.
